# Published artifacts

HTML documents written for review or decision — plans, audits,
mockups, teardowns. They are the design history of this project. Kept here because the
published copy lives on someone else's server and the working copy used to live in `/tmp`.

**Point-in-time records — do not edit them to reflect later decisions.** Supersede with a
new document and link back. Self-contained: open one in a browser, no server needed.
